summary.text: Avalon Lewis is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Lewis is retired and self-employed as a mobile disc jockey, and also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Avalon Lewis attended Manchester College in Manchester, New Hampshire, and Ballotpedia lists him as retired and self-employed as a mobile disc jockey.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he immigrated from the Caribbean 50 years earlier, came to New Hampshire 38 years earlier, settled in Nashua with his wife about 10 years earlier, and had been self-employed in the entertainment industry for 22 years.
Lewis was a Republican candidate for Hillsborough 7 in 2024 and was defeated in the November general election by three incumbent Democrats.
He advanced from the Republican primary again on September 8, 2026.
